target.statement: EDVR trained on RAW-Noise synthesized data achieves 31.68 dB PSNR on BSD (2-16 ms) test subset

compute.basis: Training EDVR for 1000 epochs on 3800 frames requires GPU; CPU training would take days, and the UHFRaw dataset and BSD test set may not be publicly available.

blockers: BSD test set may require application
title: Towards Real-World Video Deblurring by Exploring Blur Formation Process
